note: The street trees and the park trees (plans 0005 and 0020). tools/geo/build.py puts them along the roads and in the parks and writes data/geo/build/trees.json. The trees on the hills come from the canopy map (data/geo/build/canopy_trees.json) in the game, with the types of data/trees/types.json. A mix gives the share of each tree type. The game shows each type in the season of the game date. Tree types (data/trees/types.json): bang, shade, tall_shade, flame, frangipani, casuarina, coconut, fan_palm, araucaria. The mixes and the spacings are builder values from photos and the culture notes: check.

canopy.comment: Report 0020, D-0020-03: the tree tops of the canopy map of 2019. On the roads of my photos (Quang Trung, the coast roads, and the named roads) and in the park of Bãi Trước, the rows stay, and a tree moves to the nearest free tree top within snap_m. On the other main roads, a tree stands on each tree top within edge_m of the road edge, and in the other parks on each tree top in the park. Builder values: check.

street.comment: Plan 0020, Q1: until the species of the main roads are known, a mix of bàng, flame trees, and shade.

bai_truoc_road.comment: Quang Trung, the road along Bãi Trước (the coast road that the homestay search finds). Large old bàng trees stand between the road and the park, with coconut palms behind them (culture notes, Confirmed). The trees stand between the road and the sea.

named_roads.comment: Roads with their own trees (plan 0020, Q1, photos that I chose).

parks.comment: Near Bãi Trước: mostly coconut palms, some bàng, a few casuarinas (plan 0020, Q2).

lean_near.comment: Plan 0026, R9: many coconut palms of the park of Bãi Trước lean by 10 to 35 degrees, in all directions (the photos of S2 of 2014, Wikimedia Commons, trungydang, CC BY 3.0). The share and the angles are builder values from the photos.

groves.name: S2
groves.comment: Report 0026, D-0026-17: the grove of leaning coconut palms of the photo of S2 (Commons, trungydang, 2014-04-05, CC BY 3.0, docs/reference/photos/shot_s2_2014.jpg), in the frame of S2 (the eye of data/showcase/shots.json, from 5 m to 50 m, 40 degrees to each side of its heading): about 20 palms 5 m to 8 m apart on the lawn (6.5 m: with 5 m, the 39 palms of the grove made S2 370 000 triangles on Low, PT-73), most of them leaning by 10 to 35 degrees, more to the sea (to -x) than to other sides. The Norfolk pines of the photo stand at its side to the sea (the grove S2 pines). The trees of the other rules in the outline give their place to the grove. The spacing, the parts, and the angles are builder values from the photo.

groves.name: S2 pines
groves.comment: Report 0026, D-0026-17: the Norfolk pines at the right of the photo of S2, between the grove and the walk of the sea (to -x). The trees of the grove S2 in this outline give their place to them.

groves.name: Hạ Long
groves.comment: Report 0026, D-0026-24: the band of Hạ Long from the junction with Quang Trung to Cao ốc Sen Biển (20 m to each side of the middle of its two roads). The rule coast_roads put an even row of casuarinas every 7 m there, and it hid the hall with the orange roof in S1. The photos show no row: the photo of Mapillary of 2018-07-29 (image 1927330624091805, hoangvietanh, CC BY-SA 4.0, docs/reference/mapillary/) shows the walk of the sea of Hạ Long with its parapet and its lamps of five globes, and no tree; the photo from a drone of 2021-01-30 (Commons, Tuong Lam Photos, CC BY-SA 4.0, docs/reference/photos/drone_2021_ha_long.jpg) shows the median with flower beds and a few small Norfolk pines, and no tree on the sea side; the photo of S1 (Commons, trungydang, 2014-04-05, CC BY 3.0) shows a few coconut palms in front of Khách sạn Bưu điện. So the grove has these trees only: four Norfolk pines in the median (araucaria, about 30 m apart) and three coconut palms on the sidewalk of the side of the hill in front of Khách sạn Bưu điện. Their places are by eye from the two photos (about 5 m).

osm_trees.comment: OSM natural=tree nodes and natural=tree_row ways. A tag genus or species can select the type.
